content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bathinda
content_sections.text: The notice describes AIIMS Bathinda as one of the new AIIMS, set up by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY) under an Act of Parliament. Its stated aim is to correct regional imbalances in quality tertiary healthcare and to attain self-sufficiency in graduate and postgraduate medical education. Applications are invited by the Executive Director, and the Institute is located at Jodhpur Romana, Mandi Dabwali Road, Bathinda, Punjab, 151001.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 55 posts in four tables: Professor 17, Additional Professor 4, Associate Professor 16 and Assistant Professor 18. The vacancies are provisional and subject to variation. The notice marks vacancies reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as (PwBD) within a category. If suitable candidates are not found for the Additional Professor posts, these posts can be filled by the lower cadre in the respective category in all the disciplines as advertised. The notice gives the example of the Additional Professor (SC) post in Nuclear Medicine, which can be filled by an Associate Professor (SC) or Assistant Professor (SC) candidate. Candidates eligible for the lower cadre may therefore also apply in departments where the higher post is advertised. If suitable candidates are not found for the Associate Professor posts, these posts can be filled by the lower cadre in the respective category in all the disciplines. For example, the Associate Professor (OBC) post in Cardiology can be filled by an Assistant Professor (OBC) candidate, so Assistant Professor-eligible candidates may also apply where the higher post is advertised. BLA = Both Leg and Both Arms affected; OL = One Leg; OH = One Hand; OA = One Arm; OAL = One Arm and One Leg; B = Blind; LV = Low Vision. PwBD candidates need at least 40% of the specified disability and must fulfil the functional requirements of the post to be eligible for the 4% horizontal reservation, on production of a valid disability certificate from the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or experience for each post. It says: "Essential Eligibility Criteria: As per Annexure-A uploaded on Institute website separately." Candidates must hold the educational qualification and experience as recognised by MCI/NMC/Govt. of India, otherwise candidature will be cancelled at any stage. Experience, where prescribed, is counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification. Candidates should check the official notification and Annexure-A for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Applications are invited from Indian nationals and from persons registered as Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholders under Section 7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Qualification, age and experience are counted as on the closing date, 30 November 2026. The age is counted as on the last date of submission of applications, 30 November 2026. The notice prints no minimum age. No age relaxation is available to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying for unreserved vacancies. Ex-servicemen and Commissioned Officers (including ECO and SSCO) seeking relaxation must submit documents from the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: For every post the notice adds "plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable)". It does not list the other allowances. The posts are full time and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Selected candidates are governed by the New Pension Scheme under Ministry of Finance Notification No.5/7/2003-ECB&PR dated 22.12.2003. The appointment is subject to review and probation of two years. If an appointee wishes to apply elsewhere in the first two years, a No Objection Certificate is provided as per AIIMS Bathinda rules. The appointee is on a whole-time appointment and may not accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise. Joining time is 30 days from the issue of the appointment letter; extension is considered only in exceptional cases with the approval of the Competent Authority. A candidate who joins one post cannot later change to another post offered. Detailed terms and conditions of service will be decided by AIIMS Bathinda and the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, GoI.

faq.question: Q1. How many faculty vacancies are there in AIIMS Bathinda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 55 provisional vacancies: 17 Professor, 4 Additional Professor, 16 Associate Professor and 18 Assistant Professor posts, subject to variation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online Google Form closes on 30 November 2026 at 05.00 PM IST. The hard copy must reach the Recruitment Cell by 03 December 2026 at 05:00 PM IST.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit must not exceed 58 years for Professor and Additional Professor, and 50 years for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor, as on 30 November 2026. SC/ST get 5 years and OBC 3 years of relaxation; EWS get none.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General/OBC/EWS candidates pay Rs. 2360/- and SC/ST candidates pay Rs. 1180/-, both including 18% GST. The fee is NIL for persons with benchmark disabilities and is paid online only.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for AIIMS Bathinda faculty posts?
faq.answer: Professor: Level-14-A (Rs. 1,68,900-2,20,400); Additional Professor: Level-13-A2+ (Rs. 1,48,200-2,11,400); Associate Professor: Level-13-A1+ (Rs. 1,38,300-2,09,200); Assistant Professor: Level-12 (Rs. 1,01,500-1,67,400), all of the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says the pay is plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable). It does not list any other allowance.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for AIIMS Bathinda faculty posts?
faq.answer: Fill the online Google Form, download and fill the application form from www.aiimsbathinda.edu.in, pay the fee online, and send the printed form with documents to the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Bathinda, to reach by 03 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are called for a personal interview before the Standing Selection Committee. If applicants are many, the committee may set shortlisting criteria, which may include a written examination.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. Apply separately for each post, pay the fee separately for each and submit separate hard copies with supporting documents.

faq.question: Q10. Can lower-cadre candidates apply for Additional Professor or Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: Yes. If suitable candidates are not found, those posts can be filled by the lower cadre in the same category. Candidates eligible for the lower cadre may apply where the higher post is advertised.
